description: This Java class 'ExceptionFactory' provides static factory methods to create various custom exception objects related to 'things' operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The exceptions relate to access issues, not found errors, and invalid modifications in the context of 'things' control and authorization.

classes.name: ExceptionFactory
classes.description: A final class providing static factory methods for creating specific DittoRuntimeExceptions related to 'things' operations, access control, and not found errors.

methods.name: attributesNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that attributes could not be found or accessed for a given ThingId with provided headers.

methods.name: attributeNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that a specific attribute identified by a JsonPointer was not found for a given ThingId and headers.

methods.name: featureNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that a specific feature identified by featureId was not found for a given ThingId and headers.

methods.name: featuresNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that features could not be found or accessed for a given ThingId.

methods.name: aclInvalid
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating an invalid ACL modification, with an optional message, for a given ThingId and headers.

methods.name: aclEntryNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that an ACL entry for a given authorization subject was not found for a specific ThingId.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that a feature definition identified by featureId was not found for a given ThingId.

methods.name: featurePropertyNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that a feature property identified by jsonPointer was not found within a feature for a specific ThingId and headers.

methods.name: featurePropertiesNotFound
methods.description: Creates an exception indicating that feature properties for a given featureId could not be accessed or found for a specific ThingId.
